title: Three kinds of desire
idea: Epicurus sorted desires into natural and necessary, natural but optional, and vain. Peace comes from meeting the first and dropping the last.
apply: Label your last five purchases as need, nice, or vain. Cut one vain habit this month.
remind: Meet your needs. Enjoy simply. Drop the vain wants.
who: Chloe, who earns well and still feels broke.

scenes.nar: Chloe earns well, but she feels broke every month. She wonders where the money goes.
Almost two thirds of it goes to things she did not need, and a quarter is spent just to impress.
Epicurus sorted desires into three kinds. Necessary ones, like food, shelter, and friends. Natural but optional ones. And vain ones that never satisfy.

items.x: Friends over for dinner at home

scenes.nar: She keeps the necessary, enjoys the optional in moderation, and drops the vain. She feels richer on the same salary.
